key_events: The party was ambushed by System-spawned Debt Collectors.
The hounds bypassed standard damage, using glowing tethers to drain HP and Stamina directly.
Rhea used her physical strength to resist the tether, causing the System to recalculate and target her inventory instead.
The debt tethers seized Rhea's Ash Fungus and Severed Ash-Boar Tusk before Vance crushed the hound.
The party was hit by an Audit Tax debuff that drastically reduced movement speed and drained stamina.
They barricaded themselves inside a Ruined Tollbooth to wait out the debuff timer.
A second wave of Debt Collectors attacked, using tethers to try and drain HP and inventory.
Rhea's stamina was drained to 1/150, and she lost her Scavenger Carapaces to a tether.
Vance successfully defended the door, maintaining his 10 HP until the debuff timer expired and the hounds de-rezzed.
Rhea accessed the tollbooth's dead terminal using Unit 734's interface cable.
She analyzed the combat logs, confirming the Debt Collectors were administrative constructs costing Node Mana.
She accessed the Mana Ledger, proving the overseer had a finite budget for his targeted harassment.
Rhea acquired the coordinates for the local administrative hub funding the attacks.
Vance braced the door with his Rebar, holding off the hounds at 10 HP.
Rhea used Unit 734 to interface with the dead terminal and decrypt the Administrative Coordinate Chip.
Rhea weaponized the Red-Tier Audit Compliance tag to bypass the secondary encryption layer.
The decryption completed, revealing the location of the administrative hub.
Rhea declared her plan to use the Raw Data Packet to trigger a catastrophic default on the overseer's ledger.
Vance held the door at 10 HP while Rhea formulated an escape plan.
Rhea realized the hounds, as administrative constructs, could not damage Unit 734 due to friendly-fire restrictions.
Rhea shoved Unit 734 into the doorway, causing a collision geometry error that froze the debt hounds in place.
Rhea stowed the Administrative Coordinate Chip and the party fled.
The party sprinted into the Ash Wastes, escaping the immediate mob threat.
The party arrived at the outskirts of the administrative hub.
Rhea accessed her system inventory and withdrew the Heavy Iron Ingot and Crystallized Experience.
Rhea forced a manual crafting synthesis, consuming the materials to create the Null-Value Token.
The party prepared for the final breach.
The party transitioned from the outskirts to the sanctum entrance.
Rhea prepared the Null-Value Token, relying on the knowledge that the overseer's budget was finite.
Vance struck the marble stairs with his Rebar, successfully drawing the aggro of the gold-plated guards.
